item.title: Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide (5 litres) Clearing a plot, fence line, compound or farm before planting by hand takes days and costs a lot in labour. Weed-Out 480SL is a non-selective, systemic glyphosate herbicide that is absorbed through the leaves and travels down to the roots, so grasses and broadleaf weeds die instead of regrowing. The 5-litre pack suits farmers, estate caretakers and contractors who clear land often. KEY BENEFITS - Systemic action kills the roots, which means less regrowth than slashing or hoeing - Controls annual and perennial grasses and broadleaf weeds, including tough couch grass - Saves labour on land preparation, zero-tillage planting, fence lines, paths and compounds - Economical: 5 L makes 16 to 25 knapsack loads depending on the weed - Rain-free period is short, so you can spray on the next dry morning TECHNICAL SPECS - Active ingredient: Glyphosate 480 g/L - Formulation: Soluble liquid (SL) - Type: Non-selective, post-emergence, systemic herbicide - Pack: 5 litres MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) - Young broadleaf weeds and annual grasses: 200 ml (5 L pack makes 25 knapsacks) - Perennial grasses such as couch grass: 300 ml (5 L pack makes about 16 knapsacks) At about 4 L per hectare in 200 L of water (200 ml per 20 L), one 5 L pack treats roughly 1 hectare. Always confirm the rate on your pack's label. 1. Use clean water. Half-fill the knapsack, add Weed-Out, then top up to 20 L and shake. 2. Spray actively growing weeds until the leaves are wet but not dripping. 3. Expect yellowing within a few days and root die-off soon after. 4. Avoid spraying if rain is expected within 4 to 6 hours. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines It kills any green plant it touches, so shield crops and avoid drift in wind. Keep away from water sources. Wear gloves, overalls and a face mask. Rinse the sprayer very thoroughly afterwards, or keep a separate sprayer for herbicides. WHAT'S IN THE BOX 1 × Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide (5 litres) This is a pest-control or agricultural chemical product. Use it only for the crop, pest, site and application method expressly authorised on the current Kenya-approved product label. Read the full label before opening or use. Follow the label exactly for personal protective equipment, dilution, application, ventilation, re-entry period, pre-harvest interval, environmental restrictions and any other precautions. Do not guess a dose, mix it with another product, or use it on food, animals, people or surfaces unless the label specifically permits that use. Keep the original container tightly closed and locked away from children, unauthorised persons and animals, and separate from food, drink and animal feed. Prevent spills and contamination of drains, wells, streams and other water sources. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling; wash hands and exposed skin after handling. Never reuse an empty pesticide container; follow the label and approved local hazardous-waste collection or disposal instructions. In case of suspected poisoning or significant exposure, seek urgent medical attention and show the product label. Kenya PCPB poison information hotlines listed in its labelling guidance: 0800 720 021 or 0800 730 030. ## Delivery across Kenya & Nairobi Pickup Pay by M-Pesa. Delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. Shop Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide in Kenya at Stermont Arcade.

The Total 20L Knapsack Sprayer (THSPP42002) carries a full 20 litre tank on your back, builds pressure up to 4.5 bar with the hand lever, and lets you switch the nozzle from a tight jet to a fine mist. It suits crop spraying, weed control, livestock-house disinfection and pest control around the home. KEY BENEFITS - 20 litre tank covers more ground per fill, with fewer refill trips - Adjustable nozzle: jet for reach, fine mist for even leaf coverage - Y-shaped trigger with a fibreglass lance that is light and corrosion-resistant - Light at about 2.6 kg, so it is comfortable to carry - Compatible with the insecticides, herbicides and disinfectants in our store WHERE YOU CAN USE IT - Crop protection sprays on vegetables, fruits and field crops - Weed control in fields and around buildings - Disinfecting poultry houses, livestock sheds and farm premises - Pest control sprays around the home and compound The larger tank is especially useful on bigger plots, where stopping often to refill wastes time and breaks your rhythm. MIXING AND APPLICATION GUIDE (20 L TANK) 1. Fill the tank about half full with clean water. 2. Add the measured chemical, then top up to the 20 L mark and shake well. 3. Pump to a steady working pressure. Do not exceed 4.5 bar. 4. Calibrate once: spray 20 L over a measured plot so you know how much ground one tank covers. Always follow the label of the chemical you are using for the dose, the timing and the re-entry period. CARE After each use, empty the tank, rinse it and spray clean water through the hose and lance. Keep a separate sprayer for herbicides if you can, since glyphosate residue can damage crops later. Check the nozzle and seals regularly, and store the sprayer in a shaded, dry place. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Wear gloves, a mask, overalls and boots whenever you spray, and never use the tank for drinking water. Keep chemicals and the sprayer away from children. TECHNICAL SPECS - Model: Total THSPP42002 - Capacity: 20 litres - Operating pressure: 1.5 to 4.5 bar - Power: manual (hand pump) - Lance: fibreglass, with Y-trigger - Weight: about 2.6 kg - Packaging: colour box WHAT'S IN THE BOX 1 × Total THSPP42002 20L knapsack sprayer with Y-trigger and fibreglass lance ## Delivery across Kenya & Nairobi Pickup Pay by M-Pesa. item.title: Rootex 6 Rooting Hormone (50g)
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Rootex 6 Rooting Hormone (50 g) Rootex 6 is a rooting hormone powder that helps cuttings of roses, carnations and other ornamentals form strong, healthy roots. Nurseries, flower farms and home gardeners use it for faster, more even rooting and a higher success rate. KEY ## Technical Specifications & Pack Details & FEATURES - Composition: See the product label - Target: Rooting of cuttings: roses, carnations and other ornamentals - Formulation: Powder - Application settings: Nurseries, flower farms and home gardeners MIXING & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS 1. Dilution rate: Used as a powder dip: no mixing with water is needed. Pour a small amount into a separate container for dipping, not into the main tub, to avoid contaminating the rest. 2. Application method: Take a healthy cutting with a clean, sharp knife or secateurs. Dip the cut end into the powder, tap off any extra and plant it straight away into a clean, well-drained rooting medium. 3. Coverage: The number of cuttings one pack treats depends on how many you dip; the label gives the quantity. Available in 50 g. 4. Water lightly and keep the cuttings in a warm, shaded and humid place until roots form. 5. Use clean tools and trays, choose healthy cuttings, keep the medium moist but not waterlogged and protect cuttings from direct hot sun until they have rooted. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines , HANDLING & - Wear gloves and avoid contact with skin and eyes; wash your hands after handling. - Keep out of reach of children, pets and livestock, and away from food and feed. - Store tightly closed in the original pack, in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Greenlife Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife Jambo Clean is a foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew off crops while nourishing them. It contains water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% and total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% plus ammoniacal 1.5%). It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. - Foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew - Water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% - Total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% + ammoniacal 1.5%) - Feeds the crop while it cleans the leaves - 1 litre pack - Greenlife brand - Delivered to all 47 counties WHAT ARE HONEYDEW AND SOOTY MOULD? Sucking insects such as aphids, whiteflies and scale insects feed on plant sap and pass out a sticky, sugary liquid called honeydew. It covers leaves, stems and fruits. A black fungus called sooty mould then grows on the honeydew and forms a dark coating. The coating blocks light, so the plant cannot photosynthesise well, and it makes the crop look dirty, which can lower quality and market value, especially for flowers, vegetables and fruit. HOW JAMBO CLEAN HELPS Jambo Clean is sprayed on the crop to help clean off sooty mould and honeydew. At the same time, the nutrients in the product nourish the plant. This makes it a practical choice for growers who need to clean up their crops and give them a boost. WHAT THE NUTRIENTS DO - Nitrogen supports leaf growth and green colour. Here it comes partly as urea and partly as ammoniacal nitrogen - Phosphorus supports root development, flowering and energy transfer in the plant ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Read the label before use. Wear gloves and avoid contact with eyes and skin. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Do not let spray or rinse water reach streams or ponds. Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. Read the product label and follow the stated crop, rate, mixing, timing and handling instructions. Wear the protective clothing and gloves specified by the manufacturer; avoid contact with eyes and skin and avoid breathing dust, mist or vapour. Do not exceed the recommended application rate or mix with other products unless the label permits it. Keep in the original closed container, away from children, food, drink, animal feed and water sources. Prevent spills from entering drains or waterways and follow the label and local rules for disposal. If irritation or accidental exposure occurs, follow the label first-aid instructions and seek medical advice when needed. ## Delivery across Kenya & Nairobi Pickup Order Jambo Clean online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. Shop Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer in Kenya at Stermont Arcade. ## How to use Follow the dose, water volume, timing and interval given on the label. Mix in clean water, agitate, and spray evenly so that leaves are well covered. Spray in the cool of the morning or late afternoon and avoid the heat of the day to reduce the risk of leaf scorch. Test on a few plants first if you are using it on a crop for the first time. IMPORTANT: TREAT THE CAUSE TOO Sooty mould returns if the sucking insects are still there. Scout for aphids, whiteflies and scale and control them with a suitable insecticide, following its label. Good crop hygiene, ant control and removing badly affected leaves also help.

item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (1 Litre) Kerol Disinfectant Fluid has a Rideal-Walker coefficient of 18 to 20 and is a powerful disinfectant and insect repellent for livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use. A coefficient of 18 to 20 means the fluid is many times stronger than phenol when tested under standard laboratory conditions, which is why it is described as a powerful disinfectant. Real results depend on dilution, contact time and how clean the surface is. item.title: E-POS 80mm Thermal Receipt Printer
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits E-POS 80MM THERMAL RECEIPT PRINTER IN KENYA The E-POS 80mm Thermal Receipt Printer is a point-of-sale printing device for businesses that need to produce clear transaction receipts at a checkout or service counter. It is intended for use with a compatible POS system and suitable 80mm thermal paper. Thermal receipt printing uses heat-sensitive paper, so the printer can produce text without a conventional ink cartridge or toner. This makes it a practical option for shops and service businesses that print customer receipts throughout the working day. A PRACTICAL PRINTER FOR BUSY COUNTERS A receipt printer is an important part of a point-of-sale workflow. After a sale is recorded in compatible POS software, the system can send the transaction details to the printer so the customer receives a printed record. Depending on the software and configuration, receipts may show items purchased, quantities, prices, totals, taxes, payment details and the business information configured in the POS system. The exact receipt layout is controlled by the software, not by the printer alone. The 80mm paper format provides a wider receipt area than smaller receipt formats. This can be useful where a business needs room for longer item descriptions, several line items or additional transaction information. Confirm the supported paper width and roll dimensions against the actual unit and the paper you intend to buy before ordering. HOW THERMAL RECEIPT PRINTING WORKS Direct thermal printers create an image by applying heat to specially coated thermal paper. Because the printing process does not use ink cartridges, businesses do not need to purchase ink or toner for ordinary receipt printing. The paper itself is the consumable. Store thermal rolls in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, excess heat and friction, which can affect print quality or cause receipts to darken. For consistent results, load the roll in the direction indicated by the printer's paper guide, keep the paper path clear and use rolls that meet the printer's stated width and diameter limits. If a receipt prints blank, check that the thermal paper is loaded with its coated side facing the print head. Follow the manufacturer's instructions when opening the cover or clearing a paper jam. WHERE IT CAN BE USED An 80mm thermal receipt printer may suit retail shops, supermarkets, mini-markets, pharmacies, restaurants, cafés, salons, repair counters, ticket desks and other businesses that use compatible point-of-sale software. It can support routine checkout operations by giving customers a printed record and helping staff maintain a consistent transaction process. The printer is a peripheral device; it does not independently manage stock, calculate sales or process card and mobile-money payments. Those functions depend on the connected POS software and payment equipment. CHECK COMPATIBILITY BEFORE PURCHASE Before buying, confirm the connection type supported by the exact E-POS model, such as USB, Ethernet, serial or wireless connectivity. Do not assume that every connection option is included. Check operating-system support, driver availability and compatibility with your POS application. If the printer is intended for a cash drawer, confirm that the unit has the required cash-drawer port and that the drawer and software use a compatible interface. Also verify the power adapter, plug type, paper-roll dimensions and any cables or accessories included in the package. SETUP AND EVERYDAY CARE Avoid placing liquids, dust or loose objects near the paper feed. Switch off the unit before cleaning or inspecting internal parts, and use only the cleaning method recommended by the manufacturer. Do not scrape the thermal print head with sharp objects. item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC is a liquid chelated copper suspension concentrate fertilizer. It contains copper oxychloride 700 g/L, which is 400 g/L metallic copper equivalent, and it corrects and prevents copper deficiency in vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals. It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. - Liquid chelated copper fertilizer in suspension concentrate (SC) form - Copper oxychloride 700 g/L (400 g/L metallic copper equivalent) - Corrects and prevents copper deficiency - For vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals - 1 litre pack - Greenlife brand WHY COPPER MATTERS Copper is a trace element that plants need in small amounts. It plays a part in enzyme activity, in the formation of chlorophyll and in flowering, pollen formation and grain filling. When copper is short, plants can show stunted growth, pale or twisted young leaves, poor flowering and lower yields. Cereals are especially sensitive, and deficiencies are more common in sandy, peaty and very high-organic soils. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and spraying, and wash well afterwards. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Copper compounds can be harmful to fish and aquatic life, so keep spray and rinse water out of streams, ponds and drains. Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. Shake well before use. This is a pest-control or agricultural chemical product. item.title: Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with Extension
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Buy the Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with a 6-way extension socket online in Kenya. Power cuts, sudden returns of electricity and low voltage are some of the most common reasons fridge compressors fail. This guard sits between your wall socket and your fridge or freezer, watches the supply, and cuts the power when it is unsafe so your appliance is not damaged. How it works: the guard has three indicator lights marked OFF, WAIT and ON. When the supply is unsafe it disconnects the appliance. When power returns, the guard waits for a short delay before switching back on, which gives the compressor time to settle. This protects against the damaging quick restart that often happens when electricity comes back after an outage. A bypass button lets you override the guard if you need to. The bundle also includes an Amaze 6-way extension socket with a long white cable and a UK-style plug, so you can power your TV, decoder, phone chargers and other small devices from a single wall point. The sockets are clearly spaced, and the cable is long enough to reach across most rooms. Who needs it: any household or small business with a fridge, freezer, water dispenser or display cooler. In areas where voltage drops or blackouts are common, a guard is a small cost compared with replacing a compressor or losing a freezer full of food, milk or drinks. Pack size: 1 Amaze fridge and freezer guard plus 1 Amaze 6-way extension socket with cable. Colour: white with blue label. Plug type: UK three-pin. Please check the rating printed on the guard against your appliance before you buy, and use the guard for refrigeration appliances as shown on its label. Installation is simple: plug the guard into the wall, plug your fridge into the guard, and wait for the ON light. No tools needed. Order today, choose pickup or delivery to your county, and pay with M-Pesa at checkout.

item.title: Doom Powergard Odourless Insect Killer Aerosol 600ml
item.description: Product Overview Mortein Doom PowerGard Odourless All Insect Killer Aerosol 600ml is a ready-to-use household insecticide in a 600ml aerosol can. The product is listed by the Kenya Pest Control Products Board (PCPB) as Mortein Doom PowerGard Odourless All Insect Killer Aerosol, registration PCPB(CR)1027. The Board lists its active ingredients as esbiothrin 0.1% w/w, D-phenothrin 0.03% w/w and imiprothrin 0.02% w/w, and identifies its registered public-health use as control of mosquitoes, cockroaches and houseflies. The registered entry also gives a 10-minute re-entry interval. Always read the actual container label and follow it; the registration entry is not a substitute for the label supplied with the can. What the 600ml Pack Is For This aerosol format is intended for household and indoor pest-control needs where a ready-to-use spray is preferred over a concentrate that must be diluted. It is a practical option to consider when flying insects such as mosquitoes and houseflies or crawling insects such as cockroaches are present in the home. The 600ml pack is one can, not a fumigation service or a replacement for removing conditions that attract pests. Product Identity and Registration The official PCPB public-health register identifies the odourless PowerGard product under registration number PCPB(CR)1027 and names Reckitt Benckiser East Africa Ltd as the local agent. The register describes the product for public-health control of mosquitoes, cockroaches and houseflies. Check the name, pack size and registration information on the can; other Doom formulations may have different label directions. How to Use It Responsibly Use the product only for the purpose and in the manner stated on the container label. Read all warnings before opening or spraying. Keep children, pets, food, drinking water and utensils away from exposure. Never spray people, animals or food. Avoid breathing the aerosol. Follow the label's ventilation and re-entry instructions, including the PCPB-listed 10-minute re-entry interval where applicable; if the can label gives a longer interval or additional precautions, follow the can label. Do not invent or substitute a spray distance, number of seconds, room size or application rate. Storage and Household Safety Keep the aerosol in its original container with the label readable. Store it securely, away from children, heat, flames, direct sunlight and ignition sources. Do not puncture, crush or burn the pressurised can. Keep it away from food and animal feed. Do not use a damaged or leaking container; follow the label's disposal instructions. Choosing the Right Pest-Control Option Choose this 600ml odourless aerosol when the product label and the pest problem match. For persistent infestations, termites, rodents, bed bugs or pests in inaccessible voids, an aerosol may not be suitable alone. Identify the pest, improve sanitation and exclusion, and seek qualified advice when needed. Buying the Correct Pack in Kenya This listing is for one 600ml can, not a twin pack, carton or 300ml can. Mortein Doom PowerGard is sold in several formats and fragrances, so confirm the exact pack and current stock on WhatsApp before ordering. Stermont Arcade offers Nairobi pickup arrangements and delivery to other counties, with charges confirmed by destination. M-Pesa is available at checkout. Frequently Asked Questions 1. Which pests is this product registered for? The PCPB public-health register lists mosquitoes, cockroaches and houseflies for the odourless PowerGard aerosol, registration PCPB(CR)1027. Follow the label for the permitted use. 2. What size is this listing? It is one 600ml aerosol can. It is not a multi-can pack. 3. Does odourless mean it is safe to inhale? No. Odourless does not mean harmless. Avoid inhaling the spray and follow every label warning, ventilation instruction and re-entry direction. 4. Can I use it as a substitute for…

item.description:
Romectin 1.8 EC 250ml Price in Kenya

Romectin 1.8 EC is an abamectin-based insecticide and miticide supplied in a 250ml pack. It is used in crop protection programmes where mites and leaf miners are a concern. The 250ml pack is a practical option for growers and professional users who need a clearly identified pack size for planned crop-care work. The current reference retail listing checked for this exact pack displayed KSh 200; Stermont's configured four-tier pricing trigger calculates the catalogue selling price from the documented baseline.

What Romectin is used for

The Kenyan product listing describes Romectin as a translaminar insecticide with activity against mites and leaf miners on flowers and vegetables. A historical PCPB registered-products entry identifies Romectin as containing abamectin 18g/L and records use against red spider mites on roses and leaf miner on French beans. Product registration and approved uses can change, so always confirm the current container label and current PCPB status before purchase or application. Actual coverage depends on the crop, pest pressure, approved label rate and spray equipment; no coverage estimate should be assumed from pack volume alone.

Responsible handling and application

Read the complete product label before opening or mixing. Use only the approved crop and pest combinations, follow the label's dosage, water volume, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval, and wear the personal protective equipment specified by the label. Avoid inhalation, skin or eye contact, food contamination and spray drift. Keep the product in its original, labelled container, securely closed and stored as directed, away from children, animals, food and animal feed. Never reuse an empty pesticide container. Dispose of containers and unused product according to the label and Kenyan requirements. If the label is damaged or unclear, ask a qualified agrochemical professional before use.

item.title: Topcop 50 WP 1kg
item.description:
Topcop 50 WP 1kg Price in Kenya

Topcop 50 WP is a protectant fungicide and bactericide manufactured by Osho Chemical Industries. This listing is for the 1kg pack. Osho describes the product as a copper oxychloride formulation that helps prevent infection by interfering with the enzyme system of fungal and bacterial spores. A Kenyan retailer listing checked for the exact 1kg pack displayed KSh 3,000 in stock. Stermont uses that documented retail amount as the authorized baseline input for its configured four-tier pricing trigger.

What Topcop 50 WP is used for

Osho identifies target diseases including rust, anthracnose, angular leaf spot, bacterial blight, Sclerotinia, early blight and late blight. These are label-led crop-protection uses; suitability depends on the crop, disease, timing and current Kenyan product label. Topcop is a protectant product, so it should be used as part of a sound preventive crop-health programme rather than as a promise to cure every established infection. Confirm that the crop and disease combination is specifically permitted on the container label before use.

Application information

Osho's published product information gives a rate of 50g per 20 litres of water and 2.5kg per hectare. Always treat the current approved container label as the controlling instruction, including any crop-specific variations, water volume, maximum number of applications, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval. Do not increase concentration or frequency to compensate for poor coverage or severe disease. Use clean, calibrated equipment and follow label directions for mixing, agitation and spray coverage. If the crop or disease is not named on the label, seek advice from a qualified agronomist or licensed agrochemical professional before application.

Why select the 1kg pack

This product page represents one 1kg pack of Topcop 50 WP. Osho's online catalogue also lists other pack options, but those are separate sizes and should not be confused with this SKU. The 1kg option can be useful for growers who have a planned spray programme and can calculate their requirement from the approved label rate. Actual treated area varies with crop, spray volume and programme requirements. Check the pack seal, printed batch details, formulation name and net weight when receiving the product.

Safe storage and responsible use

Read the complete label and safety instructions before handling. Wear the protective clothing and equipment stated on the label, avoid breathing dust and prevent contact with skin and eyes. Prepare spray mixture in a well-ventilated area, away from children, animals, food and animal feed. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling the product. Keep it in its original closed container in the storage conditions specified by the manufacturer. Prevent contamination of drains, ponds, rivers and other water sources. Never reuse an empty pesticide container; manage empty packaging and leftover spray mixture according to label directions and applicable Kenyan requirements.

Buying Topcop 50 WP in Kenya

When comparing fungicides, match the brand, formulation, active ingredient and pack size. Topcop 50 WP is not interchangeable with every copper fungicide or every product carrying a similar colour or pack design. item.description: Urea Falcon 50kg Fertilizer – Price in Kenya Urea Falcon is a nitrogen fertilizer listed in a 50kg bag for agricultural use. This record is intended for Kenyan farmers and farm-input buyers looking for a clearly identified urea pack. The Kenyan retail reference checked for this product was KSh 4,810 for the 50kg bag. Because retailer prices and stock status can change, confirm the current price and availability before ordering. Check the product label on delivery to ensure that the brand, fertilizer type and bag weight match the item purchased. Understanding urea fertilizer Urea is a concentrated nitrogen fertilizer used in crop nutrition programmes. Nitrogen is essential for chlorophyll formation, vegetative growth and the development of leaves and stems. It is commonly used where a crop nutrient plan identifies a nitrogen requirement. Urea does not supply the full range of nutrients needed by every crop, so it may need to be combined in a planned programme with phosphorus, potassium, sulphur or micronutrients based on soil and crop needs. Why pack size matters The 50kg bag is suitable for farms and organized growers purchasing fertilizer for a defined field programme. A larger pack can be economical where the product will be stored correctly and used within the appropriate period. Always check the net weight and guaranteed analysis printed on the bag. Do not compare prices without checking that the competing products have the same pack size and nutrient concentration. Application planning Urea application rates vary substantially with crop, soil fertility, growth stage, rainfall, irrigation and previous fertilizer use. The correct rate should come from the product label, a soil test and advice from a qualified agronomist familiar with the crop and local conditions. Do not copy a rate from another farm or assume that a rate recommended for maize is suitable for vegetables, pasture, coffee, tea or fruit trees. Where a split application is recommended, follow the specified timing and method. Urea can lose nitrogen when left exposed on the soil surface under unsuitable conditions. Follow label directions on placement, incorporation, irrigation and timing. Avoid application immediately before intense rainfall, on saturated ground or close to watercourses where runoff may occur. Do not place fertilizer directly against seed or young roots unless the product instructions specifically allow it. Use calibrated measuring equipment and keep records of field, date and quantity applied. Storage, safety and quality checks Keep urea in its original bag in a dry, cool and well-ventilated store. Protect it from moisture, rain and direct contact with wet floors. Stack bags safely and keep them separate from food, animal feed and household supplies. Close partially used bags securely. Avoid breathing dust and wash hands after handling. Keep the product away from children and animals, and follow the safety and handling instructions printed on the bag. At delivery, inspect the packaging for tears, dampness, caking or signs of contamination. Check the label, manufacturer details, net weight and batch information where shown. If the packaging or product does not match the order, contact the seller before use. item.title: Aminika WH507 Maize Seeds 2kg
item.description:
Aminika WH507 Maize Seeds 2kg is a maize seed listing for Kenyan growers comparing varieties, pack sizes and supplier information before planting. This page identifies the specific 2kg pack and records the supplier's current product details. It is intended to help farmers plan a purchase and check whether the seed suits their field, season and production objective. Harvest and yield depend on location, weather, soil, seed handling and crop management.

Product overview

This listing is for Aminika WH507 Maize Seeds 2kg, supplied as 2kg. The listed brand or product identity is Western Seed. The pack size helps you plan the acreage or nursery area, the number of rows or trays to prepare, and any reserve seed. Check the printed label, batch details and treatment warnings before opening the pack. Keep seed in its original packaging until use.

Variety characteristics and growing fit

The supplier positions Aminika WH507 for higher-altitude production around 1,200–1,600 metres, with a longer maturity window and large semi-flint kernels. Match it to the altitude and rainfall guidance on the packet. Compare this guidance with the conditions on your farm. Altitude, rainfall pattern, soil drainage, temperature and planting date all affect field performance. If your farm sits between recommended zones, ask a local agronomist or the seed supplier to confirm suitability before buying a large quantity.

Plan the field before planting

Start with the crop history of the field and the expected rainfall window. Choose a site with suitable drainage and access to water where irrigation is needed. Remove volunteer plants and manage crop residues responsibly. A soil test can help identify acidity, nutrient deficiencies and other constraints. For cereals, consider rotation with legumes where practical. For vegetables, plan nursery space, transplant dates and market timing before opening the seed pack.

Seedbed preparation and sowing

Prepare a fine, firm and reasonably level seedbed without pulverising the soil. Break large clods, remove persistent weeds and avoid planting into waterlogged ground. Handle seed with clean, dry hands and clean equipment. Use the seed rate, planting depth, row spacing, plant spacing and nursery instructions printed on the original pack; those values differ between varieties and production systems. Sow into moist soil at the recommended time and check emergence regularly.

Crop care after establishment

Base fertilizer decisions on a soil test, crop requirement and local extension advice. Apply basal nutrients and top-dressing only at the stage and rate recommended for the crop. Maintain even moisture during establishment and critical growth stages while preventing waterlogging. Inspect the field regularly for uneven emergence, weeds, insect feeding and leaf symptoms. Use integrated crop management and seek a correct diagnosis before selecting any crop-protection product.

Harvest and storage

Harvest at the stage appropriate to the crop and intended market. Dry grain safely before storage; harvest vegetables at the size and maturity required by buyers and handle produce gently. Clean and dry storage areas before use. Keep remaining seed sealed, cool and dry, away from direct sunlight, moisture, rodents and chemicals.

Pack size and authenticity checks

The pack on this listing is 2kg. Check the physical label for variety name, manufacturer or distributor, lot or batch number, packing date, expiry or validity information where shown, and treatment markings. Buy sealed packs from traceable sellers and keep the receipt. Do not rely on loose, unlabelled transfers when variety identity is important.

item.title: Tormentor 0.05% Cockroach Gel Bait 35g
item.description: Tormentor 0.05% Cockroach Gel Bait 35g in Kenya **Product overview and pack details** Tormentor 0.05% Cockroach Gel Bait is a public-health insecticide gel bait listed for the control of cockroaches in public places. This listing is for the 35g pack. It is suited to buyers who need a ready-to-use gel bait presentation for a premises where cockroach activity has been identified, including residential and commercial environments within the product's registered use. The Pest Control Products Board register identifies Tormentor 0.05% Gel under PCPB(CR)1312 and lists fipronil 0.005 g/kg as the active ingredient. Check the actual product label and pack before use; the label is the controlling source for application instructions and precautions. **Target pests and registered purpose** The manufacturer and retailer information describes Tormentor gel bait for major cockroach species, including German, Oriental and American cockroaches. The PCPB register identifies the registered use as cockroach control in public-health settings. Buyers should select the product for the target pest and site shown on the label. If the pest has not been identified, inspect the affected area or consult a qualified pest-control professional before choosing a product. **Why choose a gel bait format** A gel bait is different from an aerosol or residual spray. It is a ready-to-use bait formulation intended for placement at locations permitted by its label, rather than broad spraying across a room. The 35g tube format can be convenient for planned treatment of multiple identified points in a larger property. Do not use this product as a general surface cleaner or apply it to food, utensils, food-preparation surfaces or any area not permitted by the label. **Planning cockroach control** A good cockroach-management plan combines correct product selection with sanitation and exclusion. Identify where activity is concentrated by looking for droppings, egg cases, shed skins and movement around warm, dark or damp hiding places. Reduce access to food and water, clean grease and crumbs, empty rubbish regularly, repair leaks and close gaps where practical. Gel bait should be placed only as directed on the product label and kept away from children, pets, food, animal feed and surfaces that are routinely touched. Avoid placing bait where it can be washed away or contaminated by cleaning products. Do not combine this bait with other insecticides unless the label or a qualified professional specifically permits it. **Active ingredient and safety information** The PCPB register lists fipronil 0.005 g/kg for Tormentor 0.05% Gel and classifies the registered product as WHO Class III, slightly hazardous, with a blue colour band. Mechanical mouse traps may be considered for enclosed locations where signs of mouse activity have been identified, such as storage rooms, kitchens, cupboards, shops and stock areas. Look for droppings, gnaw marks, damaged packaging and gaps around doors or service openings. These signs can help identify likely travel routes. Place traps only in suitable locations and follow the manufacturer's setup instructions. Avoid placing them where people, pets, cleaning equipment or routine stock handling could disturb them.

Four-piece pack for multiple locations

A four-piece pack lets the user address several identified points without buying four separate single units. If activity continues or the infestation is extensive, consider a professional inspection to identify entry points and contributing conditions.

Integrated rodent prevention

Trapping works best as part of a wider prevention routine. Store food and animal feed in closed, rodent-resistant containers, clean up crumbs and spills, manage waste in covered bins, and remove clutter that can provide hiding places. Inspect doors, vents, pipe openings and wall gaps for access points and arrange suitable repairs. In commercial food-handling or storage premises, include rodent checks in routine cleaning and pest-monitoring records. These steps help reduce conditions that attract rodents and make ongoing activity easier to identify.

Handling, hygiene and storage

Although this is a non-chemical trap, it still needs careful handling. Keep unused traps clean and dry and store them away from food, animal feed and children. Follow the instructions supplied with the product when setting or resetting the mechanism. Avoid touching a captured rodent directly; use suitable protective equipment and follow public-health guidance for hygienic removal and disposal. Wash hands after handling traps or cleaning an affected area. Do not use a damaged trap or modify its mechanism. Keep the product instructions available for reference.

Who May Need the 1L Pack

The 1L pack may suit grain handlers, commercial stores, warehouse operators and trained pest-management professionals who have a verified requirement and appropriate pesticide storage. It is a larger format than the 100ml pack and should be selected only when the treatment plan and label justify the quantity. A larger bottle is not automatically more economical if the product cannot be stored securely or used within its shelf life. Confirm the intended grain, storage structure and target pest before purchasing.

Inspect the storage facility for damaged bags, gaps, old grain residues and equipment that may carry infestation between lots. Clean the store, remove spilled grain, keep the area dry and use sound bags or sealed containers. Good storage hygiene reduces infestation risk and supports any label-approved treatment. If the target pest is larger grain borer, do not assume Actellic 50EC is the correct option; the PCPB entry specifically excludes that pest.

Safe Handling and Storage

Actellic 50EC is a concentrated pesticide. Read the complete Kenyan label before opening the bottle and use only the protective equipment, measuring method, application equipment and disposal instructions stated there. Avoid skin and eye contact and do not inhale vapour or spray mist. Keep children, pets, livestock, food and animal feed away from mixing and treatment areas. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling the product. Prevent spills and keep the product away from wells, drains, streams and other water sources.

Do not apply directly to food intended for human consumption unless the exact label expressly permits that specific grain treatment and gives the required method. Observe label restrictions, waiting periods and re-entry instructions. Store the bottle upright in its original sealed container in a locked, cool and dry pesticide store, away from food, feed, medicines and water. Never transfer concentrate into an unlabelled bottle. Dispose of empty packaging and leftover material as directed on the label and under applicable Kenyan requirements.

Choosing Between 100ml and 1L

The product is registered for control of rats and mice in domestic and field settings. Product Identity and Professional-Use Restriction

Storm is supplied as wax block bait. The PCPB register identifies Sorex Ltd and BASF Agriculture Solutions Deutschland GmbH in the manufacturer information, with BASF East Africa Ltd as local agent. Do not confuse Storm with Storm Secure blocks, other rodenticides or a different active ingredient. That restriction is important: this pack is intended for a trained and appropriately authorised operator who can assess the site, plan safe placement, protect non-target animals and maintain monitoring records. It is not a recommendation for untrained household application.

Where the 3kg Pack May Fit

A 3kg pack may suit a professional rodent-management programme covering a commercial premises, farm, warehouse, food-storage site or multiple treatment points. The quantity should be selected by the operator according to the site assessment and the product label. Consider the extent of rodent activity, number of stations, site access, presence of children and animals, and the amount that can be stored securely and used within its shelf life. Inspect for droppings, gnaw marks, damaged packaging, tracks and likely entry points. Remove accessible food waste, store feed in sealed containers, repair gaps where practical and reduce clutter that provides nesting cover.

Safe Placement and Handling

Rodenticides can harm people, pets, livestock and non-target wildlife if handled or placed carelessly. Storm must be handled by professional pest-control operators following the current Kenyan label and BASF instructions. Use suitable tamper-resistant bait stations where required or recommended, secure them against movement and prevent access by children, pets, poultry and wildlife. Never scatter bait where it can be reached by people or non-target animals. Keep bait away from food, feed, drinking water, drains and water bodies. Use the protective equipment stated on the label when handling blocks or servicing stations. Record station locations and inspect them at the interval required by the label. Collect dead rodents and unused bait as directed; do not feed poisoned rodents to pets or wildlife. Store unopened bait in its original sealed container in a locked, dry chemical store away from food, feed, medicines and water.

Monitoring and Buying Guidance

Rodent activity differs between a grain store, poultry unit, home, restaurant and warehouse. The operator should identify likely access routes and food sources, and select stations and inspection intervals according to the label. Do not invent bait quantities, station spacing or replenishment schedules. If activity persists, investigate entry points and sanitation before increasing bait use. item.title: Econo Rat Bait Station 1pc
item.description:
Econo Rat Bait Station 1pc – Controlled Rodent Bait Placement

The Econo Rat Bait Station is a physical rodent-control accessory designed to provide a defined location for placing rodent bait as part of a managed rat-control programme. This listing is for one station. It is not a rodenticide, and the station should not be assumed to include bait unless the seller’s product details or the delivered package explicitly confirm that. Buyers should inspect the product contents and the station’s locking and placement features before use.

Why Use a Bait Station

A bait station helps keep rodent bait in a designated location instead of leaving bait loose on floors, shelves or other accessible surfaces. Controlled placement can make it easier to record where bait is located, inspect activity and reduce accidental contact by people and non-target animals. The station is an accessory for a rodent-management plan; it does not by itself eliminate rodents or replace sanitation, proofing and monitoring. For homes, shops, restaurants, stores, farms and warehouses, rodent control should start with an inspection. Look for droppings, gnaw marks, damaged food packaging, tracks and entry gaps. Remove accessible food waste, store feed in sealed containers, repair gaps where practical and reduce clutter that can provide nesting cover.

Choosing a Station for Your Site

Before buying, consider the site layout, likely rodent routes, presence of children and pets, access by livestock or wildlife, and whether the station will be used indoors or outdoors. Check the physical station’s size, entry points, anchoring options and locking mechanism before installation. Do not assume that every bait station is suitable for every bait block, paste or pellet. Confirm compatibility with the bait product and follow the bait label’s instructions. This listing is for one Econo station. If a larger property needs several monitoring points, plan the number of stations after inspection rather than buying an arbitrary quantity. Mark each station with an identifier and keep a site map or record so the person responsible can find and inspect every point.

Safe Use with Rodent Baits

When used with rodenticide, the bait label remains the primary guide for approved placement, station type, inspection frequency and disposal. Use only a registered bait appropriate for the target rodent and site. Keep bait inside the station and prevent access by children, pets, poultry, livestock and non-target wildlife. Do not place bait stations on food-preparation surfaces or near food, feed or drinking water. Secure the station so it cannot be casually moved or opened. Wear the protective equipment stated on the rodenticide label when handling bait or servicing a station. Wash hands after handling and record any bait added or removed. Collect dead rodents and dispose of leftover bait according to the bait label. Do not feed poisoned rodents to pets or wildlife. Store unused rodenticide separately in its original sealed container; a station is not a substitute for secure chemical storage.

Inspection, Maintenance and Buying Guidance

Inspect stations at intervals appropriate to the bait label and site risk. Look for movement, damage, moisture, contamination or signs that non-target animals have accessed the station. Replace or repair damaged equipment before relying on it for further bait placement. item.description: # Stainless Steel Bird & Pigeon Spikes – 50cm Strip ## Product overview Help discourage pigeons and other nuisance birds from perching or roosting on exposed ledges with this 50 cm bird-deterrent spike strip. It is designed for targeted bird-proofing around buildings and outdoor structures where droppings, nesting and repeated perching create cleaning or maintenance problems. The product is a physical deterrent, not a poison or chemical treatment. ## Product specifications - Pack: one 50 cm strip - Base: polycarbonate - Spike material: stainless steel wire - Spike length: 11.5 cm - Protection width: approximately 7 cm, tip to tip - Base dimensions: 50 cm long × 2.2 cm wide - Intended birds listed by supplier: pigeons, gulls, starlings, Indian mynas and sparrows Check the ledge width and total run before ordering. Measure the full area and calculate how many strips are needed, allowing for corners and gaps. ## Suitable placement and installation The supplier lists use on ledges, roofs, chimneys, gutters, fences, beams, balconies and other elevated perching points. The supplier recommends suitable outdoor adhesive or clips; it also describes fixing options such as screws, straps or cable ties where the surface and installation method permit. Use protective gloves when handling the pointed wires, keep the product away from children and do not install it where it could injure people or non-target animals. ## Choosing the right quantity One strip covers a 50 cm length. For longer ledges, measure the full run and plan adjoining strips so birds cannot simply move to an untreated section. This product is a deterrent for landing and roosting; it does not remove nests, clean droppings or seal building openings. For quantity or installation questions, contact +254 789 514 060. M-Pesa checkout is available through the store. ## Frequently asked questions **How long is one strip?** Each listed unit is 50 cm long. **Does it use poison?** No. It is a physical bird-perching deterrent. **Can it be cut or bent?** The supplier describes a flexible base, but confirm the required fit and installation method before modifying it. **How many do I need?** Measure the full ledge or roof edge and divide the length by 0.5 metres, then allow for corners and gaps. **Is delivery available outside Nairobi?** Yes.
